sources.provider: Purdue University GDSL / Indiana 3DEP LiDAR; local reproducible analysis
sources.crs: NAD83(HARN)/Indiana West ftUS EPSG:2968; NAVD88 Geoid12B ftUS
sources.measurement_method: Median class-1 surface height inside a 3 m eroded Purdue GIS footprint minus median class-2 ground elevation within the 5 m external footprint buffer; output reports feetUS-to-metre conversion and sample counts.
sources.uncertainty: No class-6 building returns in tile; class-1 includes unclassified surface returns. Edge erosion and nearby ground buffer reduce vegetation contamination but do not guarantee every sample is roof. Main roof central median is robust; outlier returns are not used as architectural roof details.
